synthesis: Tune the Scout DRIVER-side default map window to a recent-focused 'Today + Yesterday + last 7 days' framing and drop the heavy 15/30/60-day long-range layers from the driver experience, WITHOUT changing the admin (Bird's Eye) window — the two must stay deliberately decoupled. Driver and admin share one Pinia store (stores/dashboard.js, stores/map.js) + component tree, branched only by mapStore.adminMode (canonical driver-vs-admin signal, DEV-2184).

scope.summary: Frontend-only (Vue/Pinia) change gated on mapStore.adminMode. No backend change — getDateRange()/range param is already caller-agnostic and 'last_7' already spans today+yesterday+5 more days. public/build must be rebuilt + committed.

proposed_changes.change: Add exported `driverRangeOptions` = rangeOptions filtered to today + last_7 (single source of truth for the driver's recent-focused window set). rangeOptions itself unchanged.

proposed_changes.change: Render a computed `visibleRangeOptions` = adminMode ? rangeOptions : driverRangeOptions. Admin keeps all 5; driver sees Today + 7d only.
proposed_changes.reason: AC2: drop 15/30/60 pills from the driver experience.

proposed_changes.reason: AC2/Q3: skip warming 15/30/60 for drivers; keeps stores decoupled (composable owns the adminMode branch).

proposed_changes.reason: Let the composable scope driver prefetch without coupling dashboard store to map store.

proposed_changes.change: prefetchAllRangePaths(ranges = null): use ranges ?? full 5-list. Default preserves current behavior.

questions.q: Q1 (boot behavior): boot into 7-day historical vs keep Live boot + prune pills vs new combined mode.
questions.answer: Keep Live boot, just prune pills — driver boot behavior is UNCHANGED (Live/today, kit dot + trail). The only change is which pills the driver sees and prefetches. No liveMode/default-range change.

questions.q: Q2 (long-range pills): remove 15/30/60 entirely from the driver UI vs keep tappable but not default.
questions.answer: Remove entirely for drivers — driver DateRangeControl shows only Today + 7d; admin/Bird's Eye keeps all five.

questions.q: Q3 (prefetch): trim driver prefetch to skip 15/30/60 vs leave as-is.
questions.answer: Trim driver prefetch — skip warming 15/30/60 for drivers (gated on adminMode); admin prefetch unchanged.

notes: Ticket's 'Currently the driver view is Today (red line) + historical 7 days (black lines)' does NOT match code: code boots into Live (map.js:154 liveMode=true, comments cite DEV-1959/DEV-2076 'Live is always the default on login'). The red/black view is what you get AFTER tapping a 7d+ pill. This discrepancy is what makes Q1 material.
'Today (red)/history (black)' is per-trip coloring within ONE selected historical range (ScannerMap scanPathColor), NOT stacked named-range layers.
isRangeActive()/selectRange() couple dashboard.range + mapStore.liveMode; any default change must keep both consistent or the pill highlight contradicts the map.
